characters.summary: Mantis is an empathic alien who fights primarily using her ability to induce sleep or alter emotions through physical touch. She relies heavily on her teammates for physical defense and offense, though she also exhibits notable physical durability and agility.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to direct physical attacks when separated from allies
Requires physical contact to use empathic manipulation powers
limitations: Powers are ineffective against targets without central nervous systems or those she cannot physically touch.

sources.supports: Mantis's empathic powers, touch requirement for sleep induction, durability, and MCU history.

feats.claim: Successfully put Thanos to temporary sleep using empathic touch during the battle on Titan.
Survived a powerful blow from Thanos that slammed her into a structure.

notableResults.note: Participated in the final battle as part of the assembled hero forces, but was eventually overwhelmed along with others.

campaignTags.claim: Can manipulate emotions and induce instant sleep in targets through touch.

unknowns: The exact upper limit of her empathic control on extremely powerful cosmic beings without prior weakening.

characters.summary: Maria Hill is a highly trained human tactical agent, intelligence expert, and combatant. She fights using standard military firearms, tactical equipment, and strategic leadership without possessing any superhuman powers.
weaknesses: Standard human physical vulnerability to lethal attacks and superhuman forces
limitations: Lacks superhuman strength, durability, or regenerative healing.

sources.supports: Maria Hill's status as a S.H.I.E.L.D./intelligence agent, weapon use, and tactical capabilities.

feats.claim: Coordinated S.H.I.E.L.D. and Avengers support operations during the Battle of Sokovia.
Engaged hostile forces using standard firearms and tactical vehicles.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots S.H.I.E.L.D. aircraft and Quinjets during operations.
Uses advanced tactical communication and surveillance equipment.

unknowns: Exact details of her classified undercover assignments outside of major film appearances.

characters.summary: Miek is an insectoid gladiator warrior from Sakaar who fights with built-in blade attachments and brute physical strength. He later upgrades his body with mechanical exosuits and cybernetic weaponry.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy energy weapons and being flipped or immobilized
Relies on mechanical suit for enhanced mobility in later appearances
limitations: Biological body is small and fragile without mechanical assistance.

sources.supports: Miek's gladiator background, blade arms, cybernetic upgrades, and participation in MCU battles.

feats.claim: Fought as a gladiator in the Contest of Champions on Sakaar using dual blade limbs.
Participated in the final battle on Earth using a heavy robotic exosuit armed with blasters.

notableResults.note: Fought as part of the combined hero forces against Thanos's invading army.

conditional.ability: Enhanced combat mobility and heavy weapon use

campaignTags.claim: Rebuilt with cybernetic and mechanical components following injuries on Sakaar.
Operates a robotic combat exosuit equipped with weapons.

unknowns: Full extent of Miek's species' natural capabilities outside of engineered gladiator gear.
